name: Uno DX
source: The game follows Shunichi, a member of his school's Uno club, who wants to be the best Uno player in his school. The game can be best described as a visual novel ware Uno is a core mechanic and the only way to progress the story or get the occasional CG is playing many rounds of said card game
translation: 游戏讲述了学校Uno俱乐部成员俊一的故事，他想成为学校中最好的Uno玩家。这款游戏可以最好地描述为一款视觉小说，Uno是一个核心机制，推动故事发展或偶尔获得CG的唯一方法就是玩多轮卡牌游戏
